pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark brown polygonal regions with rounded to sub-angular vertices. The edge gradients are soft, showing a gradual pixel transition from dark to light. Patch area is significantly larger on the upper flank compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches on the visible hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank, forming a stable mesh-like topology.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, horizontal, thin structure resembling a tail brush is visible intersecting the pixel data of the right hindquarter.
